name: Maxwell Engineering Solutions
summary: Maxwell Engineering Solutions makes and refurbishes precision parts for underwater pelletizing systems, such as die plates, blades and cutter hubs, at a Vadodara plant that started in July 2025, and earns most of its sales from exports. Total income grew from ₹10.9 cr in FY24 to ₹30.8 cr in FY26, and profit rose 29% in FY26 to ₹11.9 cr. Borrowings grew faster than income, from ₹3.2 cr to ₹16.7 cr, and the company was only incorporated in September 2022. The whole ₹57.6 cr issue is fresh money; about 42% is for new machinery and buildings, and the post-issue P/E of about 18.3x is well below the two profitable listed peers in the offer document.

checks.name: Revenue growth
checks.finding: Total income rose from ₹10.87 cr (FY24) to ₹30.76 cr (FY26), a CAGR of about 68%.

checks.name: Revenue rose every year
checks.finding: Total income grew every year: ₹10.87 cr, ₹22.59 cr, ₹30.76 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Debt to equity
checks.finding: Debt to equity was 0.56 at July 31, 2026 (borrowings ₹15.77 cr vs net worth ₹27.92 cr).

checks.name: Debt growing slower than revenue
checks.finding: Borrowings rose about 424% (₹3.19 cr to ₹16.73 cr) while total income rose about 183% over FY24–FY26.

checks.name: Net worth rising
checks.finding: Net worth rose every year: ₹3.33 cr, ₹13.01 cr, ₹24.87 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Positive operating cash flow
checks.finding: Operating cash flow was ₹7.48 cr in FY26, about 63% of the ₹11.86 cr profit.

checks.name: Profit growth
checks.finding: Profit after tax grew 29% in FY26, to ₹11.86 cr.

checks.name: Profit margin trend
checks.finding: Net margin on total income rose from 29.1% (FY24) to 40.6% (FY25), then eased to 38.6% (FY26).

checks.name: Return on equity
checks.finding: Return on net worth was 47.7% in FY26 (ROE 62.6%), helped by the small equity base.

checks.name: Return on capital employed
checks.finding: ROCE was 38.5% in FY26.
